name: Acceptance test 22A - malformed JSON blocks (originally passing; protect against regression)
note: IAM-707 fixturization of an originally-PASSING case. Structurally invalid JSON (an unterminated Statement array) must BLOCK analysis with a JSON syntax error and produce NO findings, risk score, or graph from partially parsed input. policyRaw carries the exact malformed text (it cannot be expressed as a clean JS object).
